messages:
Marta: Heads-up — delta transport escrow for private bundle v2.3.1 is staged. Need final checksum verify + escrow key health check before the 02:00 UTC cutover window.
Kevin: Packaging finished and artifacts are uploaded to internal GCS: gs://redwood-private/releases/v2.3.1/delta/. sha256sums.txt present. Also pushed the airgap installer tarball (installer:v2.3.1-delta).
Ari: Quick question — are we reusing the escrow transfer flow from last month or the new escrow bridge? I want to make sure the transfer path matches the on-prem mirror configs. @DeployBot will kick the transfer, right?
DeployBot: Deploy plan created: plan_id=dp-20260321-31, target=private-vpc, canary=10 hosts, window=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z..2026-03-22T02:20:00Z, rollback_policy=auto-on-threshold.
Jay: Important: pin the installer image and the runtime image in the manifest before handoff. Manifest should reference installer:v2.3.1-delta and runtime:redwood-runtime:v20260321. If we need to fall back, we will unpin to v2.3.0.
Sam (oncall): Clarify rollback signals please — propose: error-rate >= 15% across canary OR manifest-verify failures on mirror OR unrecoverable 5xx spike. Also include latency SLO breach >200ms p95 as secondary.
Kevin: Uploaded signed manifest + envelopes to escrow: s3://escrow/redwood/v2.3.1/delta/{manifest.json,manifest.env,manifest.sig}. I used the escrow KMS key alias projects/redwood/kms/escrow-key.
PackagingBot: Escrow envelope verification: OK. Manifest signature: OK. Checksums match.
Marta: Ops checklist before go: 1) KMS escrow key active + rotation window clear 2) offline mirror checksum fetch test 3) installer package TTL/pinning verified 4) release notes updated with rollback criteria and canary metrics link.
Ari: Note for airgap: assembler change required — installer-gen must embed the escrow envelope URL not the direct S3 path. I pushed a tiny patch to assembler: 
```
./bin/assembler --mode=airgap --escrow-url=s3://escrow/redwood/v2.3.1/delta/manifest.env --out=airgap-installer.tgz
```
Kevin: Confirmed. Also ran the mirror fetch smoke test against a staging on-prem mirror and it succeeds in 3/3 attempts. Logs: /artifacts/smoke/mirror-fetch/v2.3.1.txt
Jay: Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 — please mention the escrow step and the unpin fallback to v2.3.0 for customers on private bundles.
Marta: During the window I will be primary and @Sam (oncall) secondary. If we abort, plan is: 1) unpin images 2) trigger dp-rollback for plan_id dp-20260321-31 3) update status page and notify customers.
DeployBot: Canary started: canary_id=can-337, progress=3/10 hosts healthy, 5/10 passed smoke, 2/10 failing with intermittent 503s. Holding as per policy. Action_required: @Marta
Marta: Pausing cutover. Kevin — please attach logs from failing hosts and enable debug-level fetch on host-07 and host-09.
Kevin: Attaching tail from host-07 log (snippet):
```
[2026-03-22T02:05:12Z] svc:mirror-fetch error: remote 503 during object GET /v2.3.1/delta/layer-17.bin
[2026-03-22T02:05:12Z] retrier: attempt=3 backoff=2s
[2026-03-22T02:05:14Z] svc:mirror-fetch success: resumed chunked download
```
Ari: Looks like transient upstream rate-limiting in the mirror proxy. Recommendation: ramp canary throttle to 5/min, retry backoff + longer initial connect timeout. I can patch assembler flags: --mirror-timeout=20s --mirror-retries=5.
Marta: Make that change and re-run a mini-canary (3 hosts). If failures persist, we'll abort and rollback to pinned v2.3.0.
Kevin: Patching flags now and re-triggering small canary. Will report back in 5m.
Sam (oncall): FYI I'll prepare the rollback playbook and pre-fill the incident template so we can notify customers quickly if needed. :thumbsup:
Marta: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source-of-truth for the window. I'll post final go/no-go 02:00Z.
